animationLayers.method: Built-in imagegen edit mode, with mountain-moon.png as edit target. PNG sources copied into this directory, then lossily encoded to WebP quality 90 with alpha preserved. These are reconstructed animation layers, not pixel-exact extraction.
animationLayers.registration: Background canvas 1024x1536. Character canvas 1024x1536, drawn at scale 0.59 with painting-space offset (48,260); low-alpha residual extraction haze rejected in the shader.
animationLayers.backgroundPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: attached existing 1024x1536 ink watercolor wuxia mountain painting. Produce a clean background plate for animation. Remove ONLY the entire foreground swordsman including all hair, flowing cloak, clothes, boots and the sword (the figure is in left middle from approximately x40..525,y575..1085). Inpaint the area behind him naturally with the surrounding pale blue-gray mountain ridges and valley mist, and continue the cliff-top rock under his boots. Keep the rest of the painting unchanged: exact camera, framing, moon, every pagoda, mountains, distant village lights, cliff rock, foreground vegetation, paper grain, muted ink palette. No new character, no text, no symbols, no UI, no cropping or zoom. Output full 1024x1536 portrait canvas precisely aligned to the input, not a closeup. This is a technical background plate, preserve all positions and original composition.
animationLayers.characterPrompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the attached existing 1024x1536 watercolor ink painting. Extract ONLY the original foreground swordsman (entire figure including all thin hair wisps, ripped cloak tails, layered robe hems, sword, hands, boots). Remove all mountains, mist, rock, plants, sky to true transparent alpha. This is a registered animation layer: output SAME full 1024x1536 portrait canvas, with character in EXACT original location and size: bun near (279,585), hand near (360,807), sword tip near (520,943), boots near (300,1065), cloak blowing left toward (40,720). Preserve exact silhouette, pose, identity, ink brushwork, every torn fabric edge, desaturated dark gray brown colors. Do not recenter, enlarge, recompose, crop to subject, redraw, embellish, add ground shadows, text or UI. Need the original figure floating on otherwise fully transparent canvas. Preserve the full original canvas margins.
